poses.prompt:
Create ONE transparent animation reference sheet with TWO complete full-body poses of the exact SAME elf archer in the reference image. The reference is the finished combat base; preserve his identity, proportions, detailed costume, hair, green cape, cream sleeves, brown leather boots/bracers, white-fletched quiver and green/gold wooden recurve bow. Preserve the clean ink/cel shaded style exactly.

Purpose: two intermediate whole-character poses for a short left-to-right TURN animation. The source reference faces upper-left, about 30 degrees left of upward, in a relaxed held-bow ready pose. These TWO new poses bridge toward a directly rear-facing pose; the game will mirror the source and the first new pose for the right-facing half. We need anatomically correct newly drawn rotation, not a narrow/squashed copy.

Layout: a wide landscape sheet divided into exactly TWO equal-width cells, with a single complete figure centered in EACH cell. The first occupies the left half; the second occupies the right half. Identical figure height, identical foot-root baseline, generous transparent margins, absolutely no overlap across the cell border. No panel outlines, text or labels.

LEFT CELL: intermediate rear view, body and head facing upward only about 12 degrees toward upper-left. More back of head and back of shoulders visible than the source; left facial profile becomes just a tiny sliver. The shoulders, hips, feet and held bow turn consistently as one coherent character. Calm bend of the left elbow, left hand grips the undrawn bow ahead of his left side; right arm rests forward and can be partially occluded from this camera. The bowstring is relaxed, no arrow nocked.

RIGHT CELL: directly rear view, face entirely hidden, back of skull centered, shoulders face straight upward away from the camera. Same natural grounded ready stance, same left-hand held undrawn bow at lower chest/waist height ahead of the left side; right hand rests naturally forward, quiver on the right side of his back. The cape hangs close to his back with a modest side sweep. Clear, unwarped bow and clean wrist/hand connections.

Camera stays fixed, elevated rear viewpoint matching the reference. Both boots stay planted on the same imaginary ground, modest stance, center of mass between boots. Do not step, jump, shrink the body, shorten legs, change facial identity, add a hat/hood or redraw the costume. The two poses must have the same adult stylized proportions and visual scale as the source.

True RGBA transparent background: no floor, shadows, diffuse glow, mist, black/colored backdrop or checkerboard art. No effects or arrows in flight. Exactly one coherent character and one bow per cell, exactly two cells total. Keep complete bow, hair, quiver and both boots entirely visible.
poses.use: left cell used as intermediate; other directions mirrored during rendering

poses.prompt:
Generate ONE additional full-body intermediate turning pose of the exact same elf archer shown in the first reference. The first image is the character/costume/rendering identity and exact scale reference. The second image is a two-pose turn sheet; match its directly rear-facing head and shoulders in the RIGHT HALF.

Pose: the short CENTER moment of a left-to-right turn, directly rear-facing away from the viewer, slight elevated rear camera. Show the back of his hair and cape, both elf ears with no face, shoulders and hips facing straight upward. Both feet remain naturally planted in the same modest staggered stance and the same proportions as the source.
Important weapon choreography: the archer temporarily gathers his undrawn bow close IN FRONT OF HIS TORSO at waist/chest height while turning. The bow is angled forward into the scene and largely hidden by his torso and cape from this rear camera. His hands remain naturally in front, mostly occluded. Only small plausible wood/green/gold portions of the bow may peek beside the lower ribs; do not put a large upright bow silhouette outside the left or right flank. This compact centered hold conceals the weapon's lateral repositioning before he reopens the ready stance on the other side. No arrow nocked, all arrows remain in the right-side back quiver.

Keep the exact chestnut hair, green tunic/cape, cream sleeves, leather shoulder accents, waist bags, bracers, buckled brown boots, white-fletched quiver and clean crisp cel shading. The cape hangs naturally with a small side sweep. Natural adult anatomy, grounded weight, relaxed elbows. No jumping, shrinking, costume changes, raised bow above the head, extra hands or disappearing arms: normal rear-view occlusion only.

ONE complete isolated character, center of stance aligned horizontally, complete boots and hair, empty transparent margins all around. True RGBA transparency, no glow, mist, shadows, floor, effects, background, labels or panel borders. This is one middle animation key pose, not a new character design or sprite sheet.

rendering: Pillow renders complete images as a GIF; PNG originals remain untouched. Uniform import scaling, fixed foot pivot and mirroring only; no limb deformation.
scope: standalone GIF demonstration; no battle code changes or automated game verification
